technical_and_design_decisions: Use Spring Security for implementing file-based (U1), LDAP-based (U2) authentication, and role-based access control (U3).
Use Spring Integration for implementing adapters: HDFS sink (U4), HBase sink (U6), File Roll sink (U7), and JMX source (U8).
For Kerberized HDFS sink (U4), leverage Spring Security Kerberos or JAAS configuration integrated with Hadoop's security model.
For mass ingestion spike (U5), evaluate existing Spring Integration JDBC, JPA, and other database connectors, collaborate with architects, and document design options.
All implementations will follow the existing Spring Boot project structure and build system (Maven/Gradle).
Testing will use embedded or mocked external systems where possible (e.g., embedded LDAP, mini HDFS, HBase testing utility).
assumptions: The developer is experienced with Spring Framework, Spring Security, and Spring Integration.
The existing codebase is well-structured and follows standard Spring Boot conventions.
All necessary libraries (Spring Security LDAP, Spring Integration HDFS/HBase/JMX, Spring Hadoop, etc.) are available via dependency management.
No need to set up production-level external systems (LDAP server, Hadoop cluster, HBase) for development; unit tests and integration tests use mocked or embedded instances.
The spike for U5 will result only in a design document; no production code for mass ingestion will be delivered in this increment.
Documentation effort includes updating README and configuration reference files, not full user manuals.
Effort estimates assume a single developer working full-time without interruptions.

activities.activity_description: Design, code, and test file-based authentication using Spring Security. Configure user details from a file (e.g., properties or YAML) and secure all endpoints at localhost:9393. Includes unit and integration tests.
Design, code, and test LDAP-based authentication using Spring Security LDAP module. Configure connection to LDAP server, bind, and search. Secure all endpoints. Includes unit and integration tests.
Add Admin and Viewer roles, configure access rules for endpoints based on roles. Integrate with authentication from U1/U2. Includes unit and integration tests.

Develop a Spring Integration sink that writes data to HDFS with Kerberos authentication. Implement configuration for Kerberos ticket acquisition, Hadoop file system interaction, and error handling. Includes unit and integration tests (using mini DFS or mocked).

Conduct research and spike to identify integration options for ingesting data from various database systems. Collaborate with team to determine design approach. Document findings and design specifications.
Develop a Spring Integration sink for writing data to HBase. Configure table mappings, batch writes, and error handling. Includes unit and integration tests (using embedded HBase or mocking).

Develop a Spring Integration sink that writes events to the local file system with file rolling policy (e.g., time or size based). Configure file naming and rotation. Includes unit and integration tests.
Develop a Spring Integration source that publishes/subscribes to JMX notifications. Configure MBean connection and notification listener. Includes unit and integration tests.
Perform end-to-end integration tests across all implemented features. Identify and fix integration issues. Run full test suite and verify security, sinks, and source interactions.
Update project documentation (README, configuration reference) for new features. Prepare release notes and ensure build artifacts are ready for deployment.
